body:
CHANGELOG updated in GoblinFoxDragon: SSH login guest-fallback bug fixed: ~/.config/gfd-mud/env (IDUNA_AGENT_NAME/SECRET) had vanished from disk (home-dir reset, file lives outside git+outside the gfd backup target), so every idunaclient call was silently 401ing and every real SSH connection fell back to guest with the 'character does not save' banner. Re-created from IDUNA/var/agent-secrets.env, restarted gfd-mud.service, live-verified: fresh key claims a character, reconnect with the same key now resumes it (no guest fallback). (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
